Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pro-rata invoice row mapping & payment plan for Clearwave pilot

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the speedy onboarding call yesterday. Finance is asking for a slightly different invoicing approach for the pilot so we can route costs to three legal entities here in Clearwave for internal chargebacks.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood produce a single invoice that is split into discrete rows (pro-rata by usage) with entity tags on each row so our AP can auto-route?
- We need VAT to be shown as a pass-through (no mark-up) where applicable, and an outline of how you expect payment to be collected (single payment vs split wire instructions).

I've attached our PO (CW_PO_4512.pdf) and a sample CSV of how our ERP expects row-level tags. If you can sketch the mapping back to Redwood's ledger/line-item IDs that would help procurement here.

Appreciate any template/schedule you can share — we need to present to our controller by EOD next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Christina Lee
Head of Finance | Clearwave Analytics
christina.lee@clearwave.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pro-rata invoice row mapping & payment plan for Clearwave pilot

Hi Christina —

Thanks for the clear asks and for sending the PO. We can definitely produce a single invoice with split rows and entity-level tags. I've attached a lightweight pro-rata allocation template that maps the invoice rows to Redwood ledger tags and to the three Clearwave entities.

High-level approach:
- We'll generate one invoice per billing period. The invoice will contain N line items: one per Clearwave entity (pro-rata share), plus a VAT line per entity where applicable.
- Each line item will include a metadata tag in our accounting CSV (ledger_tag) that your ERP can consume for auto-routing.
- Payment: we prefer a single payment to Redwood with a remittance file that indicates how your AP should split the payment across legal entities; if you require separate wires per entity we can support that but will need explicit wiring instructions per entity.

Next steps from our side:
1) Karthik will confirm the ledger tag naming convention and VAT handling.
2) Marissa will publish the invoice template and a sample file based on the PO.
3) Diego will send a proposed staged payment schedule (we often do milestone invoices for pilots).

Attaching: pro-rata-allocation-template.csv (simple mapping + example).

If that sounds right I can draft a short one-page billing addendum to the SOW for your controller to sign.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Pro-rata invoice row mapping & payment plan for Clearwave pilot

Hi all —

Quick technical notes from accounting that will determine how we populate the CSV: 

1) Ledger tags: we'll emit ledger_tag values in the form: rw_entity_{A|B|C}_costcenter (e.g. rw_entity_A_costcenter). Please confirm the exact Clearwave entity codes we should map to so we can match your GL import.

2) VAT treatment: for US/ROW customers we typically list VAT as a separate tax line per entity. If Clearwave is reclaiming VAT, we'll label the tax line as "VAT - pass-through (no markup)" and include the VAT registration numbers in the invoice metadata. If you prefer to have VAT charged centrally and redistributed internally, that requires a different accounting flow (we can provide a list of net/gross options).

3) Payment capture options: 
- Option A (preferred): Single remittance to Redwood; we include an attached remittance CSV that your AP can use to split payments.
- Option B: Three separate wires — supported, but we need detailed beneficiary banking info per Redwood legal entity and additional bank fees may apply.

Please share: Clearwave entity codes + VAT reg numbers + preferred payment option. Marissa, let's also flag any internal discounting (pilot pricing) here so the invoice rows reflect agreed unit prices.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Finance, Billing & Tax | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-tax-note-vat.pdf
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Christina Lee <christina.lee@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pro-rata invoice row mapping & payment plan for Clearwave pilot

Christina —

Following up with a concrete staged invoice proposal so your controller can map cashflows. Proposed schedule (pilot = three billing periods):

- Invoice 1 (pilot ramp): 30% of estimated usage, due net 30 after invoice date. Rows: Entity A (15%), Entity B (10%), Entity C (5%). VAT line included per-entity where applicable.
- Invoice 2 (mid-pilot): 40% of estimated usage, due net 30. Rows split pro-rata by actual usage snapshot (we'll provide usage CSV).
- Invoice 3 (close-out): remaining 30% plus any overage/adjustments, due net 30.

We will:
- Attach a remittance CSV on each invoice that contains line-level routing (ledger_tag -> Clearwave_entity_code).
- Include VAT registration numbers and mark tax lines as pass-through ("VAT - pass-through").
- Provide both a single payee option (preferred) and separate-wires instructions as a fallback.

Action items for Clearwave:
- Confirm entity codes for mapping (A/B/C) and VAT registration numbers.
- Confirm whether you'd like one combined payee or separate wires.
- If OK, Marissa will push a short billing addendum to the SOW and we can get the signature to lock the schedule.

Below is my suggested billing addendum bullet text; if you want this as a one-pager I can convert it and attach to the SOW.

---
Billing addendum (draft):
- Redwood will issue one invoice per billing period with discrete invoice rows per Clearwave legal entity.
- Each invoice will include per-entity VAT lines marked "pass-through."
- Clearwave will remit payment either as a single payment with remittance file (preferred) or as separate wires to the designated Redwood entities.
- Payment terms: net 30.

---

If you approve I'll attach the addendum to the SOW and route for signature.
